exposure: interventional embolization of the pelvic arteries (PAE)
cohort: 20 women who underwent PAE for PPH between 2012 and 2016 at University Hospital Zurich
finding: Pelvic artery embolization was successful in 95% of patients with PPH, and those who underwent PAE largely experienced regular menstruation with potentially shorter duration, lower intensity, and decreased dysmenorrhea after the procedure.
mod_finding: The main reason for severe PPH differed based on mode of delivery: retained placenta was more common after spontaneous delivery, while uterine atony was more common after cesarean section.
